title: Wrath hub ac bypass
features:
Wrath 0.101 client-side utility UI for Roblox
Lightweight menu with ESP, aim assist, visuals, and player options. Toggle with RightAlt.
Features

ESP

Boxes, names, health, distance
Tracers + 360° off-screen tracers
Skeleton, chams (Highlight)
Team / visibility checks
NPC / rig ESP
Custom colors

Aimbot

Methods: Camera, Mouse, CameraWarp
Modes: Always / Hold / Toggle
Aim part, smoothing, prediction
FOV lock + FOV circle
Team / wall check
Aim dot
Triggerbot (delay, humanisation, burst, optional camera lerp)

Player

Velocity speed
Infinite jump / velocity jump
Fly (WASD + up/down)
Seat fly + nearby seat targeting

Visuals

Fullbright, no fog
FOV changer

Misc

Anti-AFK
Mouse sensitivity
Remote logger (read-only to Output)
Remote fire / spam tools
Clean UI close (restores cursor)
